title: Play-Nice Question and Help Artifacts
description: One generalized schema family for help interactions. play-nice/question-v1 is the human-facing question (with choices and recommendation); help-request-v1/help-response-v1 (same schema, kind discriminant) are the agent-to-agent forms. A question is resumable workflow state with provenance — never a chat message, never authorization, never secret-bearing.

schema.description: question-v1: human-facing decision request. help-request-v1: agent-to-agent capability request. help-response-v1: the answer artifact.

question_id.description: Stable identifier. Persists across sessions; referenced by decision provenance.

status.description: Lifecycle states — one canonical machine vocabulary. Human renderers may use any friendly wording; wire/machine values stay stable. Legacy lowercase forms (waiting_for_answer, answered) are accepted by the validator as parse aliases but never emitted canonically.

reason.description: Why the question is being asked — what is ambiguous, conflicting, or missing.

question.description: The question itself, answerable in one decision. For help-requests: the needed capability or operation.

checked.description: What the requester already inspected before asking (discover-before-asking discipline).

choices.description: Labeled options for the respondent. Absent when freeform input is appropriate.

recommended.description: The recommended choice id or freeform recommendation, if any. A recommendation is not the answer.

confidence.description: Confidence in the recommendation. Distinguishes FACT/INFERENCE/RECOMMENDATION rather than flattening them.

blocking.description: True when work cannot safely continue without the answer.

if_unanswered.description: What happens if nobody answers (e.g. 'preserve current state, return WAITING_FOR_HELP').

affected_scope.description: Screens, services, files, or resources this decision affects.

evidence.description: References supporting the question (file paths, frame ids, API responses). No inline secrets — references only.

answer.description: The received answer. Information only — NEVER authorization (see Authorization).

answer_kind.description: What kind of answer this was; decisions become provenance.

resulting_action.description: What was done as a result, for decision provenance ('because it asked, and this was the answer').

needed_capability.description: help-requests only: the capability sought (e.g. browser-visual-inspection).

inputs.description: help-requests only: structured inputs the helper needs (routes, reference paths). No secrets.

expected_output.description: help-requests only: expected shape of the result.

secrets_policy.description: Marker field: help artifacts structurally exclude secret material; sensitive data uses secure mechanisms instead of pasting.
